tex_content.html:
Proposition
[short-time control of cutoff derivatives] Source: cao-zhu 1. Claim 2\group Cao–Zhu Derivative Estimates For $ heta >0$ sufficiently small in terms of $b,B,A$, if $r\le heta /\sqrt M$, $t\le heta /M$, and $F\le H$, then \[ | abla \varphi |^2\le 2A^2,qquad \varphi | abla ^2\varphi |\le 2A^2. \]
Proof

\sketch Evolve the first and second covariant derivatives of the time-independent cutoff in the evolving orthonormal frame. The bound $F\le H$ controls $| abla \Rm |$, and Gronwall estimates give both inequalities for sufficiently small $ heta $.

□
